D1-194.q: Azure Machine Learning ka kaunsa tool data scientist ko mukhtalif groups ke logon ke liye model ki ghaltiyan aur fairness parakhne mein madad deta hai?
opts: Azure Cost Management ki reports
Responsible AI dashboard
D1-194.exp: Azure Machine Learning ka Responsible AI dashboard error analysis aur fairness assessment jaise tools ko ek jagah laata hai, is liye aap dekh sakte hain ke model kaunse groups ke liye kharab kaam karta hai. Azure Advisor aam mashware deta hai, Cost Management kharche par nazar rakhta hai, aur Azure Policy resources ke usool lagu karta hai; koi bhi model ki fairness nahi parakhta.

D1-195.q: Fairness ke baare mein neeche diye gaye har bayan ke liye, agar bayan sach hai to Haan chunein, warna Nahi chunein.
stmts: Fairness ka matlab hai ke AI system sab ko ek hi nateeja de, un ke halaat kuch bhi hon.
Pehli release se pehle fairness check kaafi hai, chahe model baad mein update ho jaye.
Training data kaise jama kiya gaya, is ka fairness par koi asar nahi.
D1-195.exp: Pehle ka jawab Nahi: fairness ka matlab ek jaise halaat wale logon ke liye ek jaise nateeje hain; mukhtalif halaat mein nateeje mukhtalif ho sakte hain. Doosre ka Nahi: model ka naya version ya naya data nayi na-barabari la sakta hai, is liye fairness checks dohrane chahiye. Teesre ka Nahi: adhoori numaindagi wala ya biased data unfair models ki aam wajah hai.

D1-196.q: Kaunsa bayan reliability and safety principle ko bayan karta hai?
opts: AI systems har customer ke liye jitne ho sakein saste hon
AI systems ghair mutawaqqa halaat mein bhi mehfooz chalein
AI systems sirf raat ko chalein
AI systems release hone ke baad kabhi update na hon
D1-196.exp: Reliability and safety ka matlab hai ke AI system umeed ke mutabiq chale, nuqsan deh cher-chaar ka muqabla kare aur un halaat mein bhi mehfooz rahe jin ke liye woh nahi bana tha. Kharcha, din ka waqt aur updates se bachna responsible AI principles nahi, aur system ko bharosemand rakhne ke liye updates aksar zaroori hoti hain.

D1-197.q: Har khali jagah ke liye sahi option chun kar jumlay mukammal karein.
D1-197.tpl: Model ko aise inputs se test karna jo us ne training mein nahi dekhe, {0} check karne mein madad karta hai. Production mein system fail ho to kya karna hai, is ki tayyari ka matlab {1} banana hai.
D1-197.exp: Na dekhe hue aur ghair mamooli inputs se testing dikhati hai ke system apne training data se bahar bharosemand aur mehfooz hai ya nahi. Incident response plan batata hai ke production mein kharabi ko kaise pakra, roka aur theek kiya jaye. Transparency aur inclusiveness doosre principles hain, aur pricing ya marketing plans kharabiyon ko nahi sambhalte.

D1-198.q: Ek team model ko aisi support emails par fine-tune karna chahti hai jin mein customers ke naam aur phone numbers hain. Kaunsa qadam privacy ko sab se behtar support karta hai?
opts: Emails shaya kar dein taake doosre data check kar sakein
Zyada epochs ke liye train karein
Bara model istemal karein
Training se pehle zaati data hata dein ya chupa dein
D1-198.exp: Training se pehle zaati data hatane ya chupane ka matlab hai ke model customers ke naam aur phone numbers seekh kar baad mein dohra nahi sakta, jis se privacy mehfooz rehti hai. Emails shaya karne se data zahir hota hai, aur zyada der training ya bara model quality aur kharcha badalta hai, privacy nahi.

D1-199.q: Generative AI chat app design karte waqt kaunsi DO baatein privacy ke lihaz se ahem hain? Har sahi jawab mukammal hal hai.
opts: Model ki sab se bari dastiyab context window istemal karna
Users ko batayein ke un ka data kaise istemal aur mehfooz hota hai
Catalog mein sab se zyada parameters wala model chunna
Prompts mein ghair zaroori zaati data na daalein
Dark color theme rakhein
D1-199.exp: User data ke istemal aur hifazat ke baare mein wazeh hona, aur sirf woh zaati data bhejna jo kaam ko chahiye, dono privacy ki hifazat karte hain. Context window ka size aur parameters ki tadad salahiyat aur kharche par asar dalte hain, aur color theme design ka intikhab hai; koi bhi zaati data ki hifazat nahi karta.

D1-200.q: Ek benefits app aasan zaban, chhote qadam aur saada layout istemal karti hai taake zehni (cognitive) mazoori wale log usay istemal kar sakein. Yeh kaunse principle ko support karta hai?
D1-200.exp: Mukhtalif salahiyaton wale logon, jin mein zehni mazoori wale bhi hain, ke liye design karna inclusiveness hai. Fairness ek jaise logon ke liye barabar nateejon ke baare mein hai, accountability is baare mein ke system ka jawabdeh kaun hai, aur privacy and security data ki hifazat ke baare mein.

D1-201.q: Users ke har group ko us inclusive design feature se milayein jo un ki madad karta hai. Har feature ek baar istemal ho sakta hai, ya bilkul nahi.
items: Aasani se type na kar sakne wale users
targets: Screen reader support aur image alt text
Tarjuma aur kai zabanon mein jawab
D1-201.exp: Screen readers aur alt text na-beena users ki, captions aur transcripts na sun sakne wale users ki, voice input un logon ki jo aasani se type nahi kar sakte, aur kai zabanon ka support doosri zabanein bolne walon ki madad karta hai. Temperature model ke output ki variety badalta hai aur accessibility ke liye kuch nahi karta.

D1-202.ctx: Bank ki website ka chat loans ke baare mein maloomat deta hai. Bohat se customers baad mein kehte hain ke unhein pata nahi chala ke woh AI system se baat kar rahe the, aur unhon ne jawabon ko kisi employee ka zaati mashwara samjha.
D1-202.q: Bank ko sab se pehle kaunse responsible AI principle par kaam karna chahiye?
D1-202.exp: Customers ko pata hona chahiye ke woh kab AI se baat kar rahe hain aur woh kya kar sakta hai aur kya nahi, yahi transparency hai. Chat ko wazeh taur par AI batana aur us ki hudood samjhana yeh ghalat fehmi door kar dega. Scenario mein ghair barabar nateejon, accessibility ki rukawaton ya ghair mehfooz rawaiye ka koi ishara nahi.

D1-203.q: Kaunse TEEN amal transparency principle ko support karte hain? Har sahi jawab mukammal hal hai.
opts: Model ki ghaltiyan users se chupana taake woh bharosa karein
AI ke banaye hue content par label lagana
Users ko batana ke woh AI system se baat kar rahe hain
Users ko system ki hudood samjhana
App ke AI istemal karne wala notice hatana
D1-203.exp: Bane hue content par label lagana, hudood samjhana aur users ko batana ke woh AI se baat kar rahe hain, teenon logon ko samajhne mein madad dete hain ke unka wasta kis cheez se hai. Ghaltiyan chupana aur notice hatana ye samajh khatam kar dete hain.

D1-204.q: Accountability principle par chalne wale idare mein bare asar wale AI system ke release ki manzoori kis ko deni chahiye?
opts: Muqarrar owner ya review board
AI model ko khud
Koi bhi user jo maange aur jis ka account ho
Kisi ko nahi, kyunke AI systems khud apna intizam karte hain
D1-204.exp: Accountability ke liye wazeh insani ownership aur governance chahiye, jaise muqarrar owners ya review board jo release se pehle idare ki AI policy lagu kare. Model jawabdeh nahi ho sakta, aam users system ke zimmedar nahi, aur AI systems khud apna intizam nahi karte.

D1-205.q: Accountability ke baare mein neeche diye gaye har bayan ke liye, agar bayan sach hai to Haan chunein, warna Nahi chunein.
stmts: Accountability ka matlab hai ke koi na koi audit kar sake ke AI system kaise istemal hua.
Bahar ke vendor ka model istemal karne se us ke istemal ki aap ke idare ki jawabdehi khatam ho jati hai.
Jab koi insan zyada khatre wale AI faislon ka review kare to idaray ko un ke records ki zaroorat nahi rehti.
D1-205.exp: Pehle ka jawab Haan: audit records dikhate hain ke system ne kya kiya aur tehqeeq mein madad karte hain. Doosre ka Nahi: jo idara AI system deploy karta hai woh us ke istemal ka jawabdeh rehta hai, chahe model vendor ka ho. Teesre ka Nahi: insani nigrani aur records mil kar kaam karte hain, kyunke records se baad mein dekha ja sakta hai ke kya faisla hua aur kyun.

D1-206.q: Users batate hain ke company ka AI assistant nuqsan deh mashware de raha hai. Incident response ke qadam sahi tarteeb mein rakhein. Har qadam istemal nahi hota.
items: Wajah ki tehqeeq karein aur usay theek karein
Agle planned release tak reports nazar andaz karein
Monitoring aur user reports se masla pakrein aur us ki tasdeeq karein
Mutasir users ko batayein aur seekhe hue sabaq likhein
Masle ko rokein, maslan feature band kar ke ya filters sakht kar ke
D1-206.exp: Zimmedar response pehle masle ki tasdeeq karta hai, phir mazeed nuqsan rokne ke liye usay jaldi qabu karta hai, phir asal wajah dhoond kar theek karta hai, aur aakhir mein mutasir logon ko batata aur sabaq likhta hai taake dobara na ho. Reports nazar andaz karna accountability aur reliability and safety ke khilaf hai.

D1-207.q: GPT jaise model ke liye pre-training ka kya matlab hai?
opts: Pehle version ke liye system message likhna
Woh Azure region chunna jahan model chalega
Bare, aam dataset par pehli training
Nayi deployment ka quota aur region tay karna
D1-207.exp: Pre-training bohat bare aur wasee dataset par ibtidai training hai jis mein model zaban ke aam patterns seekhta hai; GPT ka P 'pre-trained' hai. System message likhna, region chunna aur quota set karna baad mein hota hai, jab aap model istemal ya deploy karte hain.

D1-208.q: Bohat se large language models kai zabanon mein sawalon ke jawab kyun de sakte hain?
opts: Unhein bohat si zabanon mein likhe text par train kiya gaya
Woh har request ke liye translation service call karte hain
Woh har zaban ke liye alag deployment istemal karte hain
Woh nahi de sakte; woh sirf English mein kaam karte hain
D1-208.exp: Large language models aise training data se seekhte hain jis mein bohat si zabanein hoti hain, is liye woh un zabanon ko seedha samajh aur likh sakte hain. Woh har request translation service se nahi guzarte aur har zaban ke liye deployment nahi chahiye hoti, halaan ke quality zabanon ke darmiyan mukhtalif ho sakti hai.

D1-209.q: Neeche diye gaye har bayan ke liye, agar bayan sach hai to Haan chunein, warna Nahi chunein.
stmts: Fine-tuning prompt mein documents shamil karta hai aur model ke weights nahi badalta.
Agli request ko zaroorat ho to grounding data prompt mein dobara shamil karna lazmi hai.
Grounding model ke weights hamesha ke liye badal sakta hai.
D1-209.exp: Pehle ka jawab Nahi: ye grounding ki tareef hai; fine-tuning mazeed training hai jo model ke weights badalti hai. Doosre ka Haan: grounding, jaise RAG, har request ke waqt prompt mein mutalliqa content shamil karta hai, aur model usay baad mein yaad nahi rakhta. Teesre ka Nahi: grounding sirf maujooda request par asar dalti hai; model khud nahi badalta.

D1-210.q: Har tafseel ko us term se milayein jise woh bayan karti hai. Har term ek baar istemal ho sakti hai, ya bilkul nahi.
items: Bohat bare dataset se aam patterns seekhna
Apni label ki hui misaalon se model ko dhaalna
Train kiye hue model se prompt ka jawab banana
Nikale hue documents prompt mein shamil karna
D1-210.exp: Pre-training bare dataset se aam patterns seekhti hai, fine-tuning aap ki misaalon se model ko dhaalti hai, inference train kiye hue model se output banana hai, aur retrieval augmented generation nikale hue documents prompts mein jorta hai. Quota allocation deployment ki setting hai, model ke seekhne ya jawab dene ka marhala nahi.

D1-211.q: Har khali jagah ke liye sahi option chun kar jumlay mukammal karein.
D1-211.tpl: 'The capital of France is' wale text ke baad language model sab se mumkina agla {0} predict karta hai. Model ka size aksar us ke {1} ki tadad se bataya jata hai.
D1-211.exp: Language models agla token predict kar ke text banate hain, yahan ghaliban 'Paris'. Model ka size aam taur par parameters ki tadad se bataya jata hai, yaani network ke andar seekhe hue weights. Images, regions aur deployments woh cheez nahi jo model predict karta hai ya jis se us ka size naapa jata hai.

D1-212.q: Ek company ko aisa language model chahiye jise woh zaroorat par download kar ke apne servers par chala sake. Kis qism ka model munasib hai?
opts: Aisa model jo sirf hosted API ki soorat mein dastiyab ho
Image-generation API
Speech service
Open-weight model, jaise Phi model
D1-212.exp: Open-weight models, jaise Microsoft ki Phi family, apne weights shaya karte hain, is liye unhein Foundry mein deploy ya apne infrastructure par chalaya ja sakta hai. Sirf hosted API wale models download nahi ho sakte, aur image-generation APIs aur speech services alag qism ki services hain.

D1-213.q: Aap ki app ko 300 page ka document ek hi request mein model ko bhejna hai. Model ki kaunsi khoobi sab se ahem hai?
opts: Sab se kam qeemat
Bari context window
Image-generation support
Speech output
D1-213.exp: Context window un tokens ki zyada se zyada tadad hai jo model ek request mein process kar sakta hai, is liye bohat lambe document ko bari context window wala model chahiye, warna document ko torna hoga. Qeemat, image generation aur speech output yeh tay nahi karte ke document samayega ya nahi.

D1-214.q: Model card ki kaunsi DO maloomat yeh tay karne mein madad karti hain ke model aap ke solution ke liye munasib hai? Har sahi jawab hal ka ek hissa hai.
opts: Catalog mein provider ke logo ka rang
Supported input aur output ki qismein
Banane wale ka abai shehar
Context window aur output ki zyada se zyada lambai
Hafte ka woh din jab model release hua
D1-214.exp: Supported inputs aur outputs batate hain ke model aap ka data, jaise images ya audio, sambhal sakta hai ya nahi, aur context window aur output ki hadd batati hai ke woh kitna process kar ke de sakta hai. Logo ke rang, banane walon ke shehar aur release ke din kaam ke liye munasib hone ke baare mein kuch nahi batate.

D1-215.q: Model chunne ke baare mein neeche diye gaye har bayan ke liye, agar bayan sach hai to Haan chunein, warna Nahi chunein.
stmts: Reasoning models aam taur par chhote chat models se zyada der mein jawab dete hain.
Catalog ka har model har zaban ko barabar achi tarah support karta hai.
Aasan classification ke kaamon ke liye chhota model kaafi ho sakta hai.
D1-215.exp: Pehle ka jawab Haan: reasoning models jawab se pehle sochne par izafi waqt aur tokens kharch karte hain. Doosre ka Nahi: zaban ka support aur quality models ke darmiyan mukhtalif hoti hai, is liye model card dekhein aur test karein. Teesre ka Haan: aasan kaamon ko aksar sab se bare model ki zaroorat nahi hoti, aur chhote models tez aur saste hote hain.

D1-216.q: Aap chahte hain ke brainstorming session mein model wahi khayalat dohrane ke bajaye naye mauzu laye. Kaunsa parameter barhana chahiye?
D1-216.exp: Presence penalty un tokens ka imkan kam karta hai jo pehle ek baar bhi aa chuke hon, jis se model naye mauzu ki taraf jata hai. Max tokens lambai mehdood karta hai, stop sequence nishan par output khatam karta hai, aur seed output ko mukhtalif ke bajaye zyada qabil-e-dohrai banane ke liye hai.

D1-217.q: Testing ke dauran aap chahte hain ke wahi prompt aur settings har run mein zyada ek jaise output dein. Kaunsa parameter madad karta hai?
opts: Seed parameter set karna
Presence penalty barhayein
Stop sequence shamil karein
Maximum tokens barhayein
D1-217.exp: seed parameter service se kehta hai ke qabil-e-dohrai tareeqe se sample kare, is liye wahi seed aur settings wali ek jaisi requests aam taur par wahi output deti hain; yeh koshish ki hadd tak hai, guarantee nahi. Presence penalty mauzu ki variety badalta hai, stop sequence output khatam karta hai, aur max tokens lambai mehdood karta hai.

D1-218.q: Har parameter ko us ke asar se milayein. Har asar ek baar istemal ho sakta hai, ya bilkul nahi.
targets: Mehdood karta hai ke jawab kitna lamba ho sakta hai
Control karta hai ke har token ka intikhab kitna random ho
Muqarrar string aane par output khatam karta hai
Wahi tokens dohrane ko kam karta hai
Deployment ka data zone set karta hai
D1-218.exp: Temperature randomness control karta hai, max tokens lambai mehdood karta hai, stop sequence chuni hui string par output khatam karta hai, aur frequency penalty takrar kam karta hai. Data zone request parameter se nahi balke deployment type, jaise Data Zone Standard, se tay hota hai.

D1-219.q: Deployment types ke baare mein jumlay mukammal karein.
D1-219.tpl: Pay-per-token billing, jis mein processing kisi bhi Azure region mein ho, {0} deta hai. Reserved capacity, jis ka bill provisioned throughput units mein aata hai, {1} deta hai.
D1-219.exp: Global Standard fi token qeemat leta hai aur requests ko Azure ki global capacity mein bhejta hai. Provisioned deployments provisioned throughput units mein naapa hua throughput reserve karti hain, jis ki qeemat istemal ho ya na ho deni hoti hai. Global Batch asynchronous bulk jobs ke liye hai, aur Data Zone Standard data zone ke andar pay-per-token hai.

D1-220.q: Jab standard deployment ko apne tokens-per-minute quota se zyada requests milein to kya hota hai?
opts: Model zyada sahi ho jata hai
Agla minute shuru hone tak billing ruk jati hai
Deployment delete ho jati hai aur dobara banani parti hai
Izafi requests ko HTTP 429 errors milti hain
D1-220.exp: Jab traffic deployment ki rate limits se barh jaye to service izafi requests ko rok kar 429 errors deti hai, is liye clients ko backoff ke saath dobara koshish karni chahiye ya aap quota barhayein. Quota se barhna accuracy nahi badalta, billing nahi rokta aur deployment delete nahi karta.
